Part 2: Error Metrics How wrong is a model? These functions measure the gap between actual and predicted values.

Mean Absolute Error (MAE) Mean Absolute Error (MAE) measures how wrong predictions are, on average. Think: For each pair (actual, predicted), what's the simplest measure of "how wrong"? Why use absolute value instead of plain difference? How do you combine all the individual errors into one summary number? Write for 1-D lists.
